_comment: Placeholder / evasion phrases an LLM tends to emit instead of translating. A phrase is only flagged when it appears in the TARGET page but NOT in the corresponding SOURCE page, so legitimate occurrences (e.g. 'TBD' in a source table) are not false positives. Extend freely; pass a custom file via --keywords.
